title: A text template for the synthetic fallback, and the product flows' results kept beside the test runs
request: Owner: add a text template (support tickets with text, plan, area, urgent) to R&D's synthetic fallback so text problems never get Telco data; and record and store the data of the product end-to-end flows.
plan: a failing test: a text problem gets a text template, its text drives the outcome
the tickets template and its keywords
the flows' results kept whole as a run in training_records/test_runs and beside the kept workspace

decisions.decision: the text template wins only when no task template matches
decisions.why: text words usually name a task's inputs ('churn from complaints and emails'): the task decides the table

decisions.decision: the text template's words match whole words (a plural too)
decisions.why: 'text' must never find 'texture'; the other templates keep their prefix matching ('unsubscrib', 'anomal')

decisions.decision: no business-hours flag in the tickets table
decisions.why: drawn apart from submitted_at it contradicted the time for about 40% of rows: a trap nobody planted on purpose

decisions.decision: the e2e results go where the suite's runs go, with the same index keys
decisions.why: the store's test_runs keeper and the archive already take that folder whole; one place for every run

change: dclab_rnd/draft/synthetic.py (tickets template, keyword rule), tests/test_draft_synthetic.py, scripts/product_e2e.py (keep_results; each flow's result collected), tests/test_e2e_keep.py.

findings.defect: a text problem got the Telco churn table when the model was off
findings.scenario: 'I want to build the text classification' with the model refused by the budget cap: 'the built-in Telco customer churn template'
findings.cause: no text template; churn is the default when no keyword matches
findings.fix: a support-tickets template whose text drives the outcome, chosen by text words
findings.test: template routing cases; outage tickets urgent more than twice as often

findings.defect: a churn prompt with text inputs got the tickets table
findings.scenario: 'Predict churn from customer complaints and emails': tickets 2, churn 1
findings.cause: topic words outvoted the task word
findings.fix: tickets only when no task template matches
findings.test: routing cases for churn, credit and fraud beside text words

findings.scenario: 'Measure the texture of materials' routed to tickets
findings.cause: keywords had no closing word boundary
findings.fix: whole words (with a plural) for the text template

findings.scenario: 1,986 of 5,000 tickets outside 9 to 17 marked business hours
findings.cause: the flag was drawn independently of the time

findings.defect: the product flows' results were only printed
findings.scenario: make product-e2e: the workspace was kept, but which flows passed, their numbers and times were lost after the screen
findings.fix: keep_results: a run in training_records/test_runs (indexed in runs.jsonl) and e2e_result.json beside the workspace
findings.test: tests/test_e2e_keep.py; a real run kept 5 flows

measurements.name: affected tests
measurements.result: test_draft_synthetic 37, test_e2e_keep 2, test_synthetic_design 6, test_draft_flow 52, plus sensitivity, studio, lessons, data limits: all pass

measurements.name: product-e2e
measurements.result: 5 of 5 flows passed; results kept in training_records/test_runs/2026-10-26/*-e2e-*.jsonl.gz

outcome: With the model off, a text problem gets a support-tickets table whose text carries the signal; every product end-to-end run keeps its results for the store.
lessons: A fallback keyword list must let the task decide over words that name inputs.
A test that only prints its results loses them: keep every run where the other runs are kept.
risks: the tickets template is one text shape (support tickets); reviews or emails get the same columns
